packageRules.description: Stay on Jersey 2.x: 3.x+ switched to jakarta.ws.rs (this code uses javax.ws.rs) and 4.x is compiled for JDK 17+, while this module builds on JDK 8/11 — a major bump is a jakarta+JDK migration, not an auto-bump, and throws UnsupportedClassVersionError at test runtime. Minor/patch within 2.x still flow. Remove only together with that migration.

Stay below configservice-sdk 0.21.0: 0.21.0 moved its admin client to jakarta.ws.rs and no longer brings javax.ws.rs-api, which RegisterClientExceptionHandler imports (it arrived only through the SDK). Taking 0.21.0 broke master on 2026-09-15 (Jenkins #2906). Remove only together with moving that handler off javax JAX-RS.
janitor-hold: configservice-sdk 0.21.0 no longer ships javax.ws.rs. Janitor holds this repo back, so no update automerges until the hold is released.
